title: Gout: treatment and diet
what: Gout is when crystals build up in a joint and it suddenly becomes inflamed. The doctor relieves the attack and chooses treatment so that attacks do not come back.
why: For sudden severe pain and swelling in a joint, often the big toe; or when uric acid in the blood is high.
duration: the visit usually takes 20 to 30 minutes, test results in 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: When the attack happened and which joint hurt
Which medicines you take - some raise uric acid

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood for uric acid is usually taken on an empty stomach. Ask the clinic.

prepare.title: Diary
prepare.text: Write down what you ate and drank before attacks.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own, even if the joint no longer hurts.

bring: Joint scans, if you have them
steps: The doctor asks about attacks and diet
Sends you for a blood test and sometimes a joint ultrasound
Sometimes takes fluid from the joint for testing
If attacks are frequent, chooses a medicine that lowers uric acid
feel: Examining the sore joint may be painful
The blood test is a short needle prick
after: Limit alcohol, especially beer, red meat and sweet fizzy drinks
Gout medicines are taken for a long time - do not stop on your own
Check-up tests follow your doctor's schedule
red_flags: A hot, badly swollen joint with high fever - see a doctor urgently

faq.q: Can gout be cured with diet?
faq.a: Diet helps, but medicines are often needed too. Your doctor decides.

faq.q: Why did an attack start after I began treatment?
faq.a: This can happen in the first months. Do not stop the pills, tell your doctor.

reminders.text: Gout visit tomorrow. If you are having a blood test, do not eat after dinner. You may drink water.
